name: Bent Wires
source:
A lonely android with a dark secret finds companionship in an abandoned AI. And while their friendship quickly turns into something more, it devolves into a one-sided nightmare just as fast.

[From [url=https://killjoyconstruct.itch.io/bent-wires]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个有着黑暗秘密的孤独机器人在一个被遗弃的人工智能中找到了陪伴。虽然他们的友谊很快就变得更加美好，但它也很快变成了一场单方面的噩梦。

[来自[url=https://killjoyconstruct.itch.io/bent-wires]itch.io[/url]]
